snippet.title: Ice Poseidon EXPECTED MORE from GTA VI 🤦‍♂️🤯
snippet.description:
Ice Poseidon is a livestreamer and internet personality known for his gaming content, real-life adventures, and unpredictable reactions. He originally built an audience through gamin before becoming widely recognized for his interactive content and willingness to bring viewers along on his everyday experiences. Over the years, he has developed a reputation for sharing his honest opinions, exploring different environments, and getting involved in unexpected situations. His personality and unfiltered reactions have become an important part of what makes his content entertaining, especially when he encounters something that doesn't meet his expectations.

One of the biggest reasons open-world games become so popular is the freedom they give players to explore an environment that feels alive. Beyond impressive graphics and a compelling storyline, many players pay attention to the smaller details that make a virtual world feel realistic. Things like character interactions, environmental activities, everyday routines, and unexpected features can make a major difference in the overall experience. When a game takes more than a decade to arrive and is associated with an enormous development investment, expectations naturally become even higher. Players want to see those years of anticipation reflected in the smallest details.

After waiting more than a decade to experience GTA VI, Ice Poseidon was disappointed by how many everyday details he felt were overlooked. He pointed out that even basic activities seemed unfinished, using eating and brushing teeth as examples. When a character eats, the animation doesn't seem properly developed, while the teeth-brushing interaction doesn't even show the character opening their mouth. He also questioned why there wasn't even running water coming out of the faucet while brushing. What made these omissions even more surprising to him was the scale of the game's development, with independent estimates putting its cost at over $1 billion. Ice expected much more attention to these smaller details.

snippet.title: GTA 6 Review
snippet.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 reviewed by Luke Reilly on PlayStation 5. Also available on Xbox Series X|S.

"As optimistic as I was about a new GTA built in the wake of everything Rockstar learnt from the majestic Red Dead Redemption 2, I was simply not ready for just how much richer, deeper, and more satisfying Grand Theft Auto 6 has proven to be. After three weeks and over 120 hours playing it, I’m still hopelessly hooked, absorbing the world at walking speed like a tourist in a new town. I’m dazed by just how consistently I find myself noticing a new animation, unique pedestrian, or standout vehicle. I am completely enamoured with its series-best car handling and weaving through the realistically dense traffic. I am smitten with its spark-filled shootouts, potent explosions, and the brutal consequences of high-calibre exchanges. I am floored at how outright gorgeous the entire map is from any distance, and I am utterly gobsmacked at how beautifully lit it is at all times – especially dawn, dusk, and the dead of night. Exquisitely detailed, endlessly experimentable, and uncompromisingly engineered, GTA 6 has not stopped astonishing me since I started it. I regularly find myself in love with video games, but it’s extraordinarily rare that I find myself in complete awe of them. Put simply, Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played."
